📞 Grok Bot can now call your dentist for you

Elon Musk posted that Grok Bot can place phone calls. In one demo making the rounds, a bot dialed a dental office and asked whether they take a patient's insurance.

The bot stays on the line, talks to the person who picks up, and reports back in chat. Musk highlighted the feature with a simple line: it can call your dentist on the phone.

Would you let a bot call a doctor's office for you?

🧠 ChatGPT and Claude can finally share one memory

Your bots used to forget what the other already knew. Notion now lets ChatGPT, Claude and other connected apps read and write the same notes, preferences and skills in your workspace.

Three steps:
1. Connect the app in Notion's gallery, or inside the app itself
2. Paste Notion's setup prompt so the bot checks those notes before answering and saves useful work back
3. Drop the custom instructions it gives you into ChatGPT or Claude settings

Without that prompt, Notion says bots often ignore the connection. Everything lands in a Memories database you can edit. Run it once per bot.

✍️ Telegram is testing a way to rewrite your message after you hit send

In the Mac beta right now, you can turn on an AI Editor so that after you send a message it can fix typos, change the tone, or translate it — and the other person never sees an «edited» label.

Telegram may land this update in the main app next.
